root_cause.mechanism: Every completed per-row BudgetContext exits through BudgetAccumulator.record, which appends a NamespaceRecord retaining that row's diagnostic OpRecord list. The accumulator is process-global and V4 never invokes budget_reset, so retained diagnostic history grows with completed rows.
